name: 15-owner-controls-no-rules
description: The owner's controls in a workspace with no rules. An idea is added to Ideas and promoted; its contract is written in Backlog with Edit contract and completed; the owner pauses the task in Ready and continues it; the builder claims it, and while it holds the task the owner pauses the agent and resumes it; the owner changes a criterion while the task is Working, which returns it to Backlog and ends the lease, and completes the contract again, the passed criterion staying passed; three failed reviews hold the task with rounds_exceeded and the Past the round limit item, which an edit of the contract resolves; the task is completed again and passes. A second task's builder is turned off while it works, which releases the task with seat_disabled, and the first builder takes it to Done.
covers: PRD test 8 and Build order, Handoff: one of the five golden traces for a workspace with no rules (milestone 3 plan HT-1, PRD R-7); the owner commands the Needs you choices rest on (PRD Build order, Handoff: promote, edit a contract, hold and resume, and pause, resume and change a seat).
PRD Task lifecycle, Add task and Promote: Add task into Ideas opens the idea step (milestone 3 plan HE-24); Promote writes task.promoted and opens wait_contract.
PRD Task lifecycle, Edit contract in Backlog: task.contract_changed only, and the task stays in Backlog; criteria keep their identity by position and kind (milestone 3 plan HE-25).

PRD Contract edits and cancel: an edit from Working returns the task to Backlog and ends the lease with no event of its own; an unchanged criterion that has passed stays passed, a criterion whose text changed is reset to open (milestone 3 plan HE-25); Complete contract with the same criteria changes none of them.

PRD Holds and the Needs you choices: Hold opens owner_hold (wait_owner) and Resume closes it; a paused agent holds its task with seat_paused (wait_seat, the lease keeps running, milestone 3 plan HE-26) until it is resumed; Edit contract answers Past the round limit: hold.closed, then inbox.resolved with the choice edit_contract (milestone 3 plan HE-25, HE-29), and the round is kept.
PRD Agent roster and milestone 3 plan HE-27: turning an agent off releases the Working task it holds with the release reason seat_disabled, and another builder claims it.
PRD Rework and escalation: the third failed review in a row reaches the round limit (maximum_rounds 3) and holds the task after the normal move, as trace 10 shows.
